BEES.Settings.EnableTabCompletion.Name: Enable Tab Completion
BEES.Settings.EnableTabCompletion.Hint: Enable DevTools console-style tab completion in the standard macro editor.
BEES.Settings.TabSize.Name: Tab Size
BEES.Settings.TabSize.Hint: The number of spaces inserted when pressing Tab on an empty line or at indentation points.
BEES.Settings.AutoIndent.Name: Auto Indentation
BEES.Settings.AutoIndent.Hint: Automatically preserve indentation level when pressing Enter.
BEES.Settings.MaxSuggestions.Name: Max Suggestions
BEES.Settings.MaxSuggestions.Hint: Maximum number of candidate completions displayed in the suggestion popup list.
BEES.Settings.LogVerbosity.Name: Log Verbosity
BEES.Settings.LogVerbosity.Hint: Control the level of diagnostic log output sent to the developer console.
